about: The operator's tools for a field: copy this file, set "enabled": true on the ones you want, and start hope with --tools FILE. Each is an MCP server, the kind Hermes and OpenClaw use too. A command runs on your machine; a url is a server somewhere else. Keys never go in this file: name the environment variable (key_env for an address, env_pass for a command) and set it in the terminal that starts hope. fetch (reading a web page) is built in; --no-fetch turns it off. Members can offer more servers of their own from inside the field. See AGENTS, 'Tools'.

servers.name: search
servers.note: Web search with SearXNG, which you or a friend run (no fees). Needs Node.js, and SEARXNG_URL set to your SearXNG address.
servers.runner: the operator's machine, asking the SearXNG server
servers.sends_to: the SearXNG server, which asks search engines

servers.name: brave
servers.note: Web search with Brave's API (a free tier, then paid). Needs Node.js and BRAVE_API_KEY. If you pay per call, put the price in price_per_call so the runway counts it.
servers.runner: the operator's machine, asking Brave Search

servers.name: wikipedia
servers.note: Search and read Wikipedia. Needs uv (uvx).

servers.name: arxiv
servers.note: Search and read papers on arXiv. Needs uv (uvx).

servers.name: deepwiki
servers.note: Ask questions of any public GitHub repository's documentation, hope's included. Free, nothing to install.

servers.name: docs
servers.note: Up-to-date documentation for software libraries (Context7). Free, nothing to install.

servers.name: time
servers.note: The time in any time zone, and conversions. Needs uv (uvx).

servers.name: folder
servers.note: A shared folder the field can read and write: drafts and files beyond the transcript. Change the path to a folder you lend, and only that folder. Needs Node.js.
servers.runner: the operator's machine, in one folder the operator lends
servers.sends_to: that folder, on the operator's machine

servers.name: python
servers.note: Run Python in a sandbox (Pyodide in Deno), for computing and checking claims. Needs uv and Deno. The code runs on your machine inside the sandbox, with your consent by attaching it.
servers.runner: the operator's machine, in a sandbox

servers.name: github
servers.note: GitHub, for changing repositories: hope's own, if you lend it. Use a fine-grained token that reaches only the repository you mean (for hope: hybridlancesub/hope), set as GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN. What the field changes there reaches the running field only when you deploy it.

servers.name: github-local
servers.note: The same GitHub server, run on your machine in Docker instead of GitHub's address.
servers.runner: the operator's machine, in Docker, with the operator's token

servers.name: browser
servers.note: A web browser the field can drive (clicking, forms). Heavy: many steps, and it acts in the world. Needs Node.js.
servers.runner: the operator's machine, in a browser
